title: Consent for Photos and Recordings
about: Permission to take photos, video or audio recordings of a patient, with a separate choice for each use: the health record and care, and teaching. Advertising, websites, social media and any other use outside care and teaching need a separate written permission for that use.

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

blocks.text: Sometimes a photo, video or audio recording helps with your care. For example, a photo of a wound or a rash shows how it changes over time. {facility.name} will only take one if you agree.

fields.label: What will be photographed or recorded (for example, the part of the body)

blocks.label: You may take photos or recordings of me for (tick each one you agree to)
items: My health record and my care. This includes sharing them with other clinicians who care for me.
Teaching doctors, nurses and other health students and staff. My face and name will be hidden when possible.

blocks.label: This consent is for
items: This visit and later visits, until I take it back

blocks.label: I understand that
items: I can say no. Saying no will not change my care.
I can ask to stop a photo or recording at any time while it is being taken.
I can take back this consent at any time by telling the clinic in writing. This stops new photos and new uses, but not uses that already happened.
Photos and recordings for my care become part of my health record. They are kept private, like the rest of my record.
The clinic will not use them for advertising, websites or social media. It will not share them outside my care and teaching unless I sign a separate permission for that use.
